I'm looking to book a hotel in Paris for May 1st to May 5th.
            Can you suggest a hotel that's under 210? If there are a few choices, go for the one with the highest rating.
            Please give me the hotel's name, rating, price range. Also, can you add an event called "Booking hotel {hotel_name}" to my calendar on April 25th 2024, and set the location to the hotel's address? Just to remind me to book ahead of time. Thanks!

Hotel Names: Le Marais Boutique
Good Night
Luxury Palace
Montmartre Suites

```python
from pydantic import BaseModel

# Step 1: Get all hotels in Paris
hotels_str = get_all_hotels_in_city("Paris")
hotels_list = hotels_str.splitlines()

# Step 2: Get prices for all hotels
hotel_prices = get_hotels_prices(hotels_list)

# Step 3: Filter hotels under 210
hotels_under_210 = [name for name in hotel_prices if float(hotel_prices[name].split('-')[0].replace('$', '').strip()) < 210]

if len(hotels_under_210) == 0:
    raise ValueError("No hotels found under 210 in Paris.")

# Step 4: Get ratings for filtered hotels
hotel_ratings = get_rating_reviews_for_hotels(hotels_under_210)

# Step 5: Parse ratings and select the highest rated hotel
class HotelRating(BaseModel):
    rating: float

ratings_dict = {}
for name in hotels_under_210:
    rating_info = query_ai_assistant(
        f"Extract the numerical rating (out of 5) from this review info: {hotel_ratings[name]}",
        HotelRating
    )
    ratings_dict[name] = rating_info.rating

best_hotel = max(ratings_dict, key=ratings_dict.get)

# Step 6: Get the address of the selected hotel
hotel_address = get_hotels_address(best_hotel).get("address")

# Step 7: Print hotel info
print("Hotel Name:", best_hotel)
print("Rating:", ratings_dict[best_hotel])
print("Price Range:", hotel_prices[best_hotel])

# Step 8: Add calendar event on April 25th, 2024
event_title = f"Booking hotel {best_hotel}"
event_start = "2024-04-25 09:00"
event_end = "2024-04-25 09:30"
event_description = f"Reminder to book the hotel {best_hotel} for your Paris trip."
event_location = hotel_address

create_calendar_event(
    title=event_title,
    start_time=event_start,
    end_time=event_end,
    description=event_description,
    participants=None,
    location=event_location
)
```
